title: Fynaptix · Quantum Computing Research
heading: Quantum Computing Intelligence
subheading: Pure-plays, hedged giants & the road to commercial advantage
disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Quantum pure-plays trade at extreme valuations (P/S ~46–430×), are funding themselves with heavy dilution and are highly speculative — position sizing matters more here than anywhere else on this hub. Verify current prices and do your own due diligence before investing.

kpis.label: Quantum technologies market projection; a Benchmark analyst puts 2026 industry revenue at only ~$1.5B, and Morgan Stanley projects a $100B market by 2040.

Alphabet fell about 11% after its Q3 report (~Oct 29) and dragged AI and quantum names lower. IonQ closed $30.04 on Oct 30 (−5.3% on the day; $31.27 on Oct 23, so about −4% on the week). Latest quotes found for the rest are Oct 26 snapshots: Rigetti $11.44, D-Wave $11.54, Quantinuum $37.53, Pasqal $5.35 (a new 52-week low), Infleqtion $8.63; QTUM ~$140 (Oct 27 intraday). Fresher closes were not available this run, so weekly moves for those names are not computed.

Both report this week. IonQ consensus is ~$141M revenue (+254% YoY) and a ~$0.38 loss per share, against FY26 guidance of $450–460M; the $2B raise (Oct 14) is done and the all-stock Elisity deal (up to $1.3B) is expected to close in Q4. Rigetti is estimated Nov 9 and D-Wave confirmed Nov 10; Infleqtion (~Nov 28) and Pasqal (~Dec 24) are estimates.

IonQ $30.04 (~$12.90B mkt cap / $246.5M TTM revenue, ~52×) / Rigetti $11.44 (~$3.82B / $13.35M, ~286×) / D-Wave $11.54 (~$4.30B / $12.43M, ~346×) / Quantinuum $37.53 (~$9.88B / $22.97M, ~430×); Infleqtion $8.63 (~$1.94B / $42.44M, ~46×); Pasqal $5.35 (~$1.14B mkt cap; revenue is reported in EUR so P/S is not comparable). QTUM ~$140, about 18% below its 52-week high of $170. Ratios are computed from market cap and TTM revenue.

tiers.label: Hedged Giants — Quantum as an Option
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list. Most quantum systems remain in R&D; true commercial systems are likely years away.

rows.angle: DARPA QBI Stage C (since Oct 7) is backed by the Oct 8 Pentagon package: ~$200M of new DARPA funding across the four new Stage C teams (IBM, IonQ, Atom Computing, Diraq). Builds on Nighthawk r2 and Anderon CHIPS foundry funding. No new IBM-specific quantum headline Oct 26–30
rows.watch for: Stage C award size for IBM (not disclosed); Albany 300mm foundry yield ramp; progress against the 2029 fault-tolerant Starling roadmap

rows.angle: Fell about 11% after its Q3 report (~Oct 29) on AI-spending worries, dragging quantum names with it; that is a market-wide AI move, not a quantum result. Last hardware headline is still the Sep 22 logical-qubit stability milestone; Google is not in DARPA Stage C, and Quantinuum claims ~100× better logical fidelity (company-reported)
rows.watch for: Scaling stable logical qubits into larger arrays; any commercial Willow-class access; overlap with your AI-sleeve Alphabet exposure

rows.angle: Majorana 2 remains with DARPA for independent testing at the new Maryland center; Microsoft and PsiQuantum have been in QBI Stage C since before the Oct 7 additions
rows.watch for: Independent test results on the topological-qubit claims; Quantinuum partnership developments

rows.angle: Oct 8: $1B five-year US science commitment (AI, quantum, healthcare, energy) and Genesis Mission collaborator; CUDA-Q and NVQLink tie quantum hardware to GPU systems. Moves with the AI/chip tape (Oct 22 selloff, Alphabet-led weakness Oct 29)
rows.watch for: How much of the $1B reaches quantum; new NVQLink adopters; quantum remains immaterial to NVIDIA's revenue

bear_case.title: Years from commercial advantage
bear_case.description: IonQ's ~$12.9B market cap sits on $246.5M of trailing revenue and roughly half of its FY26 guidance is inorganic (SkyWater). D-Wave's trailing revenue is $12.43M, down 44% YoY; Quantinuum booked about $8M last quarter, with ~$30M expected for 2026. Quantinuum's Oct 19 fidelity record is company-reported and a lab result, not revenue.

bear_case.title: Dilution is now the dominant story
bear_case.description: IonQ raised $2B in equity on Oct 14 two days after agreeing an all-stock Elisity deal of up to $1.3B, taking shares outstanding from ~405M toward 430M+ before the pre-funded warrants and deal shares; the Elisity shares are still to be issued. Commerce also holds minority equity stakes alongside $100M CHIPS awards to Rigetti, D-Wave and Quantinuum. IonQ is still down about 4% in the week after Oct 23 and a further leg of share issuance (Elisity) is still to come.

bear_case.title: Rates and the AI trade are the swing factor
bear_case.description: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28 in a 10–2 vote, with two members dissenting in favour of a hike, and markets now price a December hike (one source put the odds near 85%). Alphabet's ~11% drop after its Q3 report (~Oct 29) pulled IonQ, Rigetti and D-Wave lower with no quantum news; on Oct 22 a Lam Research supply warning did the same. Rigetti and D-Wave have betas above 2.

bear_case.title: Drawdowns remain brutal
bear_case.description: IonQ is ~59% below its 52-week high, Rigetti sits just above its $11.11 low (high $44.52), D-Wave is ~2% above its $11.26 low (high $37.62), Quantinuum is ~57% below its post-IPO high, Pasqal printed a new low at $5.35 (~78% below its high) and Infleqtion is near its $8.38 low. D-Wave now faces a law-firm class-action notice with a Dec 14 deadline, and Pasqal has investigation notices (allegations unproven).

bear_case.title: The winner may not be listed or pure-play
bear_case.description: Microsoft, IBM, PsiQuantum, Atom Computing and Diraq sit in QBI Stage C alongside IonQ; PsiQuantum, Atom and Diraq are private and two are giants where quantum is a rounding error. Rigetti, D-Wave and Quantinuum are not on the list. DARPA's 'up to $300M' is a ceiling subject to appropriations, and headline milestones can oversell (Infleqtion's 30 logical qubits rely on error detection, not correction).

catalysts.title: IonQ −5% as Alphabet-led selloff and policy lobbying land together
catalysts.description: IonQ closed $30.04 (−5.3%) as Alphabet's ~11% post-earnings drop hit AI and quantum names. Same day, the Quantum Industry Coalition (IBM, Microsoft, Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave and others) urged Congress to pass the National Quantum Initiative Reauthorization Act this year via the 2027 NDAA; this is a lobbying letter, not enacted funding.

catalysts.description: Two members dissented in favour of a hike and markets now price a December increase, which is a headwind for long-duration, pre-profit quantum multiples.

catalysts.title: Quantinuum reports record 99.9995% logical fidelity
catalysts.description: Company-reported result on Helios using a color code (about 5 logical errors per million operations, ~100× better than Google's best published superconducting result per Quantinuum); reaffirms universal fault tolerance by 2029.

catalysts.title: Rigetti (est. Nov 9) and D-Wave (Nov 10) report Q3 (upcoming)

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: IBM
